# Cardle

> Cardle is a Sri Lankan premium cotton tote bag brand founded in 2024. All bags
> are handcrafted and made to order, with delivery across Sri Lanka in 2–7
> business days. Cotton totes start at LKR 990.

## Docs
- [Shop All](https://cardle.lk/lk/store): Full product catalogue
- [About Cardle](https://cardle.lk/lk/about): Brand story and manufacturing details
- [FAQ](https://cardle.lk/lk/faq): Shipping, returns, materials, and care questions
- [Contact](https://cardle.lk/lk/contact): Email, phone/WhatsApp, and business hours

## Products
- [Journey Tote](https://cardle.lk/lk/products/journey-tote): structured canvas bag for hands-free daily carry
- [Heritage Tote](https://cardle.lk/lk/products/heritage-tote): geometric/fish-motif print canvas tote
- [Dune Tote](https://cardle.lk/lk/products/dune-tote)
- [Cardle Cloud (bouclé) Tote](https://cardle.lk/lk/products/cardle-cloud)
- [Cardle Signature Tote](https://cardle.lk/lk/products/cardle-signature)
- [Horizon Tote](https://cardle.lk/lk/products/horizon-tote)

## Optional
- Made from 100% natural cotton canvas, zero-stretch canvas engineering
- Payment: OnePay, Koko (BNPL), Cash on Delivery
- Delivery: LKR 300 island-wide, 2–7 business days
- Custom and bulk/corporate orders available
- Contact: hello@cardle.lk · WhatsApp +94 77 949 7859 · Mon–Fri 9am–6pm, Sat 10am–4pm
